# Contributor Code of Conduct

## Consuelo's Pledge

Contributors and maintainers pledge to provide a harassment-free, inclusive, and
professional community experience for everyone.

## Consuelo's Standards

Positive behavior includes respectful collaboration, constructive feedback,
accepting responsibility for mistakes, and focusing on the health of the project and
community.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discriminatory or sexualized language,
trolling, personal attacks, publishing another person's private information without
permission, or other conduct inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing these standards.
They may remove, edit, or reject contributions or interactions that violate this
Code of Conduct and should explain moderation decisions when appropriate.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies in project spaces and when someone is officially
representing the project in public spaces.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.0:
https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/code_of_conduct.html
